description: Bruegel publishes a derived European natural gas demand collection with monthly country and EU totals, separating household, industrial and power-sector demand where sources permit. The landing page was first published in October 2022 and identifies an update in July 2026. It compiles ENTSOG and national transmission or market-operator series, supplemented by Eurostat and electricity generation sources. The documented processing repository describes country, date, demand in kWh, demand type and source fields, with daily inputs combined into monthly outputs. For power-sector consumption, the provider estimates gas burn from electricity generation using an assumed 50 percent efficiency. Coverage includes EU countries and the United Kingdom, with different sector detail and source frequency by country. The public landing page and documentation are freely accessible; a dataset reuse licence was not established. Caveats include revisions, uneven sector coverage and the conversion assumption. These demand inputs support gas-network flow and supply-capacity studies. Related record data-bruegel-european-natural-gas-imports describes the separate supply-flow collection. No data files were retrieved.
